analysis.title: The Gold Standard: Spot Gold Comparable Tables
key_insights: Comp tables are struck at spot gold US$3,522/oz and spot silver US$40.99/oz as of Nov 20, 2026, well below the RBC deck of $4,539 (2026), $4,960 (2027), $5,400 (2028) and $4,000 long-term. Valuations at spot look much more expensive than at deck.
Total average P/NAV is 1.33x at spot versus 0.98x at the RBC deck. Royalties trade at 2.03x spot P/NAV (1.62x at deck), large producers at 1.32x, intermediates at 1.03x and growth producers at 1.17x.
Royalty and streaming names carry the richest multiples. 2026E EV/EBITDA averages 18.0x at spot and P/CF about 20x. WPM (2.43x) and FNV (2.17x) are the most expensive on P/NAV.
Large producers are the cheapest liquid group on cash multiples. At spot, 2026E EV/EBITDA averages 5.3x, with KGC 3.7x, GFI 4.0x and AU 5.1x. 2026E FCF/EV averages 7.7% at spot and 8.8% at deck.
Gold equities have sold off hard with spot gold weak. Total average is -4.4% 1D, -15.2% 5D, -18.8% 1M and -28.6% 3M. Large producers average -33.1% over 3M and 44% below 52-week highs.

Silver producers and emerging developers took the worst of it. Silver producers are -57% from 52-week highs on average (HL -69%, CDE -62%) and emerging producers are -56%. Skeena fell 18.2% in one day and Sinda 18.7%.

NAV sensitivity is highest in producers. A 10% spot move changes NAVPS by about 20% on average for large and intermediate producers, versus about 10% for royalty companies. EQX (44%), SSRM (38%) and HOC (41%) are most geared.
FCF yield is very leveraged to price. Large producers' 2027E FCF/EV is 2.9% at $3,000 gold and 15.7% at $6,000. Royalties are far less sensitive.

Balance sheets are mostly net cash. Large producers average -4% net debt/market cap, with KGC -9% and AEM -4% net cash. EGO is the main levered name at 25% net debt/market cap and about 1.4x net debt/EBITDA at spot.

RBC updated estimates for DPM, GMIN, KNT, OR and WPM after Q3 results with no rating or price target changes. DPM's SFCF multiple rose to 12.0x from 10.0x. 2026E gold EPS for DPM fell to $3.13 from $3.52 and KNT's to $1.13 from $1.50.
Ratings are Outperform on most names. Sector Perform is on FNV peers TFPM, AEM, BTG, EGO, EDV, CG, LUG and WDO. Speculative Outperform covers developers such as SA, NG, PPTA and SKE.

macro_indicators.interpretation: Market price used for spot comps, well below the RBC deck for 2026.
Market price used for silver comps.
Deck is well above spot, so deck-based NAV and FCF look much cheaper than spot-based.

risk_factors: Gold equities are highly geared to the gold price. A 10% spot move changes NAVPS about 20% for producers.
Spot gold is far below the RBC deck, so deck-based targets depend on a price recovery.
Developer and emerging producers carry negative FCF and financing needs, plus speculative risk.
Cost inflation is a risk, with fully loaded costs rising for most producers.
vol_and_positioning: Gold equity drawdowns are steep, with total average -28.6% over 3M. Large producers are 44% and silver producers 57% below 52-week highs, which implies stretched positioning and high beta to gold.

key_data_points.anchor: Spot gold priced at US$3,522/oz and spot silver at US$40.99/oz, as of November 20, 2026.
